summary_1line: Bhishma explains dreams, mind, and consciousness, then distinguishes manifest body, unmanifest soul, and paths of Pravritti and Nivritti leading toward realization of Brahman.

image_candidates.scene_text: A yogin sits awake in meditation at night while dreamlike figures formed from past impressions swirl around his still mind.
The mind dissolves into a radiant inner light as the sleeper enters dreamless slumber and witnesses pure consciousness.
Two cosmic principles—Prakriti woven of three colors and Purusha as a silent luminous witness—stand distinct against the universe.
